description: NFR2-NEUT-001 token list. The neutral model - contracts/catalog/components.json and the property names and enum values of contracts/archgraph.schema.json - must contain none of these as a whole word (case-insensitive). Provider and vendor terms belong only in target data: realisation catalogues, adapters, deployment profiles. Both test suites read THIS file. Add a token here when a new provider or vendor becomes relevant; never delete one to make a test pass.
